# vision API

AI assisted recovery: proposals, approvals and the provider settings.

Base path `/api/v1/vision` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/vision.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/vision.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

### vision

#### GET /api/v1/vision/me/preferences

**My Preferences**

The caller's AI assist preferences (the defaults until saved): `stereo_frames` and the opt-in to automatic AI analyses on errors (off until saved) with the installation's limits (cooldown per mower, analyses per mower and day).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [PreferencesOut](#preferencesout) |

#### PUT /api/v1/vision/me/preferences

**Put My Preferences**

Change the caller's AI assist preferences; a field left out keeps its value.

`auto_analysis`: when a mower of the account enters a recoverable error (stuck, blocked, outside the work area, wheel slip), the service takes a photo, analyses it with the caller's provider (or the installation's) and asks for approval like a manual request; nothing is executed automatically. Enabling needs the plan feature `ai_recover` (403 `feature-not-in-plan`; nothing is saved then).

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [PreferencesIn](#preferencesin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [PreferencesOut](#preferencesout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/vision/me/provider

**My Provider**

The caller's own provider (the key only as `api_key_set`) and the provider a request would use now (`effective`).

| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ProviderOut](#providerout) |

#### PUT /api/v1/vision/me/provider

**Put My Provider**

Save the caller's provider. 422 for an unknown family, a refused base URL or bad headers; 409 `vision-secrets-unavailable` when a key is sent but cannot be stored.

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [ProviderIn](#providerin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ProviderOut](#providerout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/vision/mowers/{mower_id}/recover

**Recover**

Start AI assist for the mower: `task` `recover` or `find_dock`, optional camera snapshots (base64, each optionally with `camera`, `side` and `captured_at`; a `left` and a `right` frame of the same moment are analysed as a stereo pair when the caller's preference `stereo_frames` is on, else only the left one). The analysis runs in the background; poll `GET /proposals/{id}`. Without images the mower's gateway is asked for one. 403 `feature-not-in-plan` without `ai_recover`, 409 `vision-provider-missing` without a usable provider, 409 when a proposal for the mower is open, 429 `vision-quota` beyond the daily cap.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [RecoverIn](#recoverin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 202 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ProposalOut](#proposalout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/vision/proposals/{proposal_id}/approve

**Approve**

Approve: the chosen option runs on the caller's behalf (blades off, dead-man 1 s). The optional body picks the option (`model` or `fallback`; omitted: the default `action`). One approval per proposal; 409 `vision-proposal-expired` after `expires_at`; 422 for an option the proposal does not offer.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `proposal_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body**: `application/json` [ApproveIn](#approvein) or null

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ProposalOut](#proposalout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### ApproveIn

`POST /proposals/{id}/approve`: which option runs (the body is optional).

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `option` | `"model"` \| `"fallback"` or null | no | `model`: the model's recommendation (also a low-confidence one offered next to the fallback); `fallback`: the rule based return to dock. Omitted: the default option (`action`). An option the proposal does not offer answers 422. |

### ImageIn

A camera snapshot, base64 encoded (JPEG or PNG), optionally with the camera that took it. Two frames with `side` `left` and `right` captured at most `MOWDECK_VISION_STEREO_MAX_SKEW_MS` apart form a stereo pair.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `camera` | string or null | no | The camera's display name, e.g. `Front left`. |
| `captured_at` | string (date-time) or null | no | When the frame was grabbed (with a time zone). |
| `data` | string | yes | Base64 (standard) of the image bytes.; max length 14000000 |
| `media_type` | `"image/jpeg"` \| `"image/png"` | yes |  |
| `side` | `"left"` \| `"right"` or null | no | `left` or `right`: the frame is one of the two front cameras (stereo). |

What happened to one drive step.

Type: `"pending"` \| `"done"` \| `"aborted"` \| `"skipped"`

### ValidationError

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ctx` | object | no |  |
| `input` | any | no |  |
| `loc` | array of string or integer | yes |  |
| `msg` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | string | yes |  |

### VisionPhotoProblem

Why an analysis got no camera photo from the mower (the most likely cause, judged from the mower's state at the time and the gateway's answer).

Type: `"weak_wifi"` \| `"weak_mobile"` \| `"offline"` \| `"no_frame"`

### VisionTask

What AI assist is asked to do.

Type: `"recover"` \| `"find_dock"`

### VisionTrigger

Who started an analysis.

Type: `"manual"` \| `"error"`
